description: This header file 'UtilsgetFileContent.h' provides utility functions for file operations including reading property values from configuration files, reading file content, checking if a path is a regular file, recursive file searching with pattern matching, and expanding variables in strings using property values. It is part of the Utils namespace and defines inline functions for various file and string manipulation tasks related to configuration management and filesystem traversal.

methods.name: bool readPropertyFromFile(const char * filename,const string & property,string & propertyValue)
methods.description: Reads a property value from a given file, possibly expanding variables if the value starts with '$'.

methods.name: bool readFileContent(const char * filename,string & content)
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a specified file into a string.

methods.name: bool isRegularFile(const string & path)
methods.description: Checks if a given path corresponds to a regular file.

methods.name: bool searchFilesRec(std::vector<std::string> & pathList,unsigned int currentDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Recursively searches directories with pattern matching and exclusions, collecting matched file paths.

methods.name: bool searchFiles(string & inputPath,int maxDepth,int minDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Initiates a recursive search for files and directories starting from a given path, respecting max/min depth and exclusions.

methods.name: bool ExpandPropertiesInString(const char * input,const char * filePath,string & expandedString)
methods.description: Expands variables within a string by replacing them with corresponding property values from a file.
